Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the family’s illness, add Shen Nong’s concern to show his motivation, such as “神农很担心家人的身体”.
2. When listing the places, add one visual detail to make the journey easier to imagine, such as “高山上长着各种各样的植物”.
3. Add a short line of speech before the journey to show determination, such as “我们一定要找到能治病的植物！”

ideas.reason: It adds a fitting feeling that explains why Shen Nong wants to help his family.
It gives a concrete, story-appropriate image of one place they visit.
It adds simple dialogue and matches their goal of finding plants to help with illness.
